nodes.label: itours.mn Integrated Booking System
nodes.rationale: Bachelor thesis project (National University of Mongolia): booking system for Mongolian travel agencies where honesty of promises, not ad spend, ranks the marketplace.

nodes.label: Expectation Score
nodes.rationale: Each plan states its pros and cons; travellers rate each promise after the trip, and how closely trips matched promises ranks plans instead of ad spend. A reworded promise starts its ratings over. Computed in plan.controller.ts.

nodes.label: Front-end Web (Next.js 15 App Router + Apollo Client 3)
nodes.norm_label: front-end web (next.js 15 app router + apollo client 3)

nodes.label: Two Apps, One Repo, No Monorepo Tooling
nodes.rationale: Apps are kept independent; the GraphQL schema is the only contract between them, so no shared workspace tooling is needed.
nodes.norm_label: two apps, one repo, no monorepo tooling

nodes.label: GraphQL Schema as Sole FE/BE Contract
nodes.rationale: back-end/src/graphql/schemas is the only interface between the two apps.
nodes.norm_label: graphql schema as sole fe/be contract

nodes.label: SUPER_ADMIN Boot Seed
nodes.rationale: Seeded on every boot from SEED_ADMIN_PHONE / SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.

nodes.label: Demo Marketplace Seed (SEED_DEMO)
nodes.rationale: Empty database only; fixed random seed so every fresh database looks the same, and past trips with reviews make scores real aggregates.

nodes.label: Plan Publish Checklist
nodes.rationale: Editor refuses to submit without three pros, three cons, drive time on every day, a price, a departure and photos, forcing honest, comparable plans. Lives in plan.controller.ts.

nodes.label: Escrow Payout with COMMISSION_PERCENT
nodes.rationale: Money is held in escrow and the agency is paid total less commission the day after the trip ends; prices set in USD, shown in MNT at MNT_PER_USD. Handled in booking.controller.ts with seat lock and stages.

nodes.label: Inline SVG Route Map + Places Gazetteer
nodes.rationale: Each day's place is looked up in lib/plan/places.ts (approximate coordinates, Natural Earth 1:50m border); unknown places are left off the map and flagged in the editor.
nodes.norm_label: inline svg route map + places gazetteer

nodes.label: { success, message, ...payload } Response Envelope
nodes.rationale: Every GraphQL field returns an envelope so the front-end never reads GraphQL errors.

nodes.label: camelCase Everywhere Convention
nodes.rationale: DB columns, models, GraphQL and FE share field names so resolvers return rows as they are.

nodes.label: i18n via t() / useT() and itr_locale Cookie
nodes.rationale: All user-facing strings go through t()/useT(); locale travels as x-locale header and lives in the itr_locale cookie so server pages can read it.
nodes.norm_label: i18n via t() / uset() and itr_locale cookie

nodes.label: Env-Gated Optional Integrations
nodes.rationale: Optional integrations are enabled by presence of their env vars and degrade to no-ops.

nodes.label: postgres Compose Service (postgres:16-alpine)
nodes.rationale: Local Postgres only; credentials come from .env.local POSTGRES_DB_* vars, pg_isready healthcheck.

nodes.label: Back-end pnpm allowBuilds (skip @apollo/protobufjs)
nodes.rationale: pnpm settings only, not a monorepo; @apollo/protobufjs build script deliberately skipped.

nodes.label: Front-end pnpm allowBuilds (skip unrs-resolver)
nodes.rationale: pnpm settings only, not a monorepo; unrs-resolver build script deliberately skipped.
